title: Events and Conferences Management
overview: This course offers essential principles and practices for individuals involved in planning and organizing events, meetings, conferences, or conventions. Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the event planning process, enhance their management skills, and familiarize themselves with best practices in the event industry, preparing them to successfully run their own events or conferences. The course will also cover various event planning tools to effectively manage time, space, budget, human resources, information, materials, and potential challenges that may arise during the planning process.
audience: This course is intended for managers, supervisors, and officers engaged in the planning or management of events, exhibitions, and conferences, as well as public relations professionals.
methodology: The course is structured around four learning pillars: concept learning (lectures and presentations), role-playing (group exercises), experience sharing (roundtable discussions), and exposure to real-world challenges and policy choices faced by participants.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify different types of events and conferences to facilitate more effective planning
Organize, assess, and motivate various committees involved in event and conference management
Develop a step-by-step promotional plan to market their events and conferences
Explain the various functions involved in managing events and conferences
Prepare and oversee the financial aspects of a conference
Plan and organize various types of exhibitions
Evaluate all activities to assess their effectiveness and follow up on events
